faq.v1: How do I book a taxi?
faq.a1: Through the form on this page, via WhatsApp or by phone. We confirm your ride by email or WhatsApp.
faq.a2: Absolutely. We monitor flight times and adjust the pick-up time in case of delays. Available from Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Almere and The Hague.
faq.a3: T4XI operates the Tesla Model Y (electric) and Lynk & Co 01 (plug-in hybrid). The available vehicle is confirmed for each ride.
faq.a4: Via iDEAL (in advance), by card in the car or in cash. A monthly business invoice is also possible.
faq.a5: T4XI offers scenic day trips from Amsterdam, Almere and Rotterdam to destinations in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg — including Bruges, Cologne, Ghent and Luxembourg City.

routezoeker.heroIntro: Premium transport with a professional driver and a fixed price agreed in advance. From your doorstep to the departure hall, carefully arranged.
routezoeker.waaromKop: Our rates are designed for reliable service—not for the lowest fare.
routezoeker.faqV1: How is my fixed price determined?
routezoeker.faqA1: Enter your pickup address and destination; if a fixed route exists you'll see the price incl. VAT straight away. That price is locked on confirmation—traffic or waiting time won't change it.
routezoeker.faqV2: Do you charge surge pricing or a night rate?
routezoeker.faqA2: Never surge pricing. Rides between 23:00 and 06:00 carry a night rate of +15%, already included in your price—no surprises afterwards.
routezoeker.faqV3: What if there's no automatic price?
routezoeker.faqA3: For routes or stops without a fixed price we'll gladly make a proposal. Request it via WhatsApp or email and we'll include your entered details automatically.

fairFare.tekst: Premium service starts with professional drivers. That's why every T4XI rate is built around fair driver pay, representative vehicles and transparent fixed prices—without surge pricing.
fairFare.afsluiting: No hidden surcharges. No dynamic price hikes. Just a rate that keeps reliable premium service possible.
